_b / _bN.meaning: back/background render layer; numeric suffix splits multiple back sublayers
_b / _bN.confidence: high when CFX z is negative

_f / _fN.meaning: front/foreground render layer; numeric suffix splits multiple front sublayers
_f / _fN.confidence: high when CFX z is nonnegative

_target.confidence: high from SRMD target effect fields and CFX names

_mask.meaning: mask/stencil companion layer paired with a visible effect

_shake / camera_path / _cmN.meaning: camera shake/path/camera motion, normally AncillarySource rather than a visible Spine layer
_shake / camera_path / _cmN.confidence: high from SRMD camera fields and directory resolution

_1 / _2 / _3 ....meaning: ordered variant, phase, or split layer; the number alone does not guarantee front/back semantics
_1 / _2 / _3 ....confidence: medium; interpret together with CFX z and parent CFX

notes: An unreferenced JSON may be loaded indirectly by code, localization selection, or a CFX outside the extracted dependency set.
Repeated CFX sources are often intentional multi-instance particles/layers with different delay or transforms.
Canvas width/height come from the Spine skeleton metadata; exact x/y AABB is not serialized in Spine 3.8 JSON.
Animation duration is the maximum serialized keyframe time in each animation object.
